title: The whole train
summary: Every repository in the chock train and how a policy travels from chock-catalog through chock to the hook your agent's client runs.
intro: chock-catalog holds the policies. chock compiles them and wires them into a repository or a plugin. agentseam's adapters speak each agent's hook dialect. Around them, the threat ledger, context-report, this site and the release check each read the train at a pinned commit.

nodes.label: Threat ledger
nodes.card: A human-reviewed weekly ledger of published agentic-AI threats, each scored against what the catalog does about it: enforced for a slice, advisory, policy wanted, or out of scope. It blocks nothing itself.

nodes.label: Policy catalog
nodes.card: One folder per policy under base/: a manifest, its checks and its evals. registry.yaml lists every policy; tools/gen_registry.py writes it from the folders on disk.

nodes.label: chock.sh
nodes.card: This site. sitegen builds every page from the catalog at .catalog-ref and the engine at .framework-ref, and refuses a catalog checked out at another commit.

nodes.label: Release check
nodes.card: Checks one release manifest across the train: every repo at a commit on its default branch, CI green there, the catalog and this site pinned to the manifest's engine commit, and no release tag yet. Tagging runs only after this check passes, on the owner's approval.

nodes.label: chock eval export
nodes.card: Exports chock policies to context-report's run/v0.1 case format. chock writes the format; it never imports context-report.

nodes.label: chock compile
nodes.card: Reads a policy folder and runs one emitter per surface: the ambient rule, agent hooks, git hook, CI step, Claude managed settings and the MCP gateway. The output lands in .chock/compiled/<policy>/.

nodes.label: chock sync
nodes.card: Recompiles and rewires a repository so it matches its declared policies: each agent's hook file, the runtime in .chock/bin/, and the git hooks unless --skip-hooks. With --ci it also installs the CI gate workflow.

nodes.label: Plugin install
nodes.card: Builds the policies picked on this site's builder into one merged plugin for one agent, and swaps it into place (ask the user before running it). No repository changes.

nodes.label: context-report
nodes.card: An open report format for whether an agent plugin, hook, skill or AGENTS.md works: one row per measured fact, each marked recomputable by anyone or only claimed by the author.

nodes.label: .chock/compiled
nodes.card: One folder per policy and surface: gate.json files, hook fragments, the ambient rule, and the git-hook and CI entry points. The cited file is the catalog's own compiled gate for one policy.

nodes.label: Per-agent runtime
nodes.card: One file per agent in .chock/bin/ (claude_code.py, cursor.py and the rest): agentseam's bundled dispatcher and adapter plus chock's gate handler. Each agent's hook command runs it with --gate or --guard.

nodes.label: Plugin folder
nodes.card: Where a client's plugin goes, and what chock may replace there. The plugin carries a runtime built the same way, for its one agent.

nodes.label: CI gate step
nodes.card: A CI step that re-runs the policy's check over a pull request's commit range, so a change that skipped the local hooks is still judged.

nodes.label: git hooks
nodes.card: The git-hook dispatchers that run each policy's git-hook entry point at commit and push.

nodes.label: agentseam adapters
nodes.card: One adapter per agent: it parses that client's hook payload into one Event, and speaks the Decision back in the client's own dialect, on stdout and in the exit code.

nodes.label: Your agent's client
nodes.card: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI and the others run the hook before a tool runs. What a hook can do there, and what happens when it cannot run, depends on the agent.
